evidence.quote: Several expressed a willingness to expand the size and duration of those purchases in the near future
The information reviewed at the meeting indicated a continued sharp contraction in real economic activity.
All but a few saw the risks to growth as tilted to the downside
Many participants noted some risk of a protracted period of excessively low inflation
Members noted that it may be necessary to expand these programs, but had somewhat different views about the best way of doing so.

parsed.rationale: The minutes describe a sharp contraction, downside risks to growth, risk of inflation that is too low, and willingness to expand asset purchases while keeping rates at 0 to 1/4 percent. Some participants noted upside inflation-expectation risks tied to unwinding, but the signal is strongly dovish on net.
